article.title: Kartal misses out on Wuhan Open title against Chwalinska
article.summary: Britain's Sonay Kartal misses out on the Wuhan Open title after a 2-6 6-4 6-2 defeat by French Open runner-up Maja Chwalinska. The final caps a remarkable run for Kartal in only her third event since returning from a six-month lay-off with a back injury.
